root_cause.text: The `eui64_mt6` function in the `ip6t_eui64` netfilter module fails to reject packets with invalid MAC headers when the fragmentation offset is zero, allowing unsafe access to the Ethernet header.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states the existing guard "only rejects an invalid MAC header when `par->fragoff != 0`," and the patch diff confirms the fix by removing the `&& par->fragoff != 0` clause from the validation condition in `net/ipv6/netfilter/ip6t_eui64.c`, ensuring all packets with invalid MAC headers are dropped before accessing `eth_hdr(skb)`.

vuln_statements.explanation: Based on the vulnerability root cause, the eui64_mt6 function performs unsafe access to eth_hdr(skb) without validating that the packet has valid MAC headers when fragmentation offset is zero. This line directly accesses the Ethernet header structure without checking IP6CB(skb)->frag_off or other fragmentation indicators, allowing potential out-of-bounds memory access on malformed packets.
